answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The vine edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 94 clones produces a signature the sparrow analysis flags immediately. An adversary must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, and hence doing work rather than printing keys, and the wharf settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
